title: Easy Rider
description: Two free spirits (Peter Fonda, Dennis Hopper) on chopped motorcycles clash with the Establishment and meet a boozy lawyer (Jack Nicholson) as they cross America.

title: A Man for All Seasons
description: Sir Thomas More (Paul Scofield) opposes Henry VIII's (Robert Shaw) appointing himself head of the Church of England.

title: 5 Against the House
description: Friends (Guy Madison, Kim Novak, Brian Keith) join a college student's scheme to rob a Reno casino for kicks.

title: Good Neighbor Sam
description: A San Francisco adman (Jack Lemmon) poses as his wife's friend's (Romy Schneider) husband so that she can inherit $15 million.

title: American Madness
description: The president (Walter Huston) of a bank believes in lending money to anyone who needs it.

title: Divorce American Style
description: A couple (Dick Van Dyke, Debbie Reynolds) break up after 15 years of marriage, then get back together as the easy way out.

title: The Howards of Virginia
description: Politics divide a Williamsburg couple (Cary Grant, Martha Scott) as events lead to the Revolutionary War.

title: Let's Do It Again
description: A composer's (Ray Milland) singing-and-dancing wife (Jane Wyman) tries to make him jealous, but it backfires into a divorce.

title: Holiday
description: A tomboy New York socialite (Katharine Hepburn) flirts with her stuffy sister's (Doris Nolan) down-to-earth fiancé (Cary Grant).

title: Under the Yum Yum Tree
description: A lusty landlord (Jack Lemmon) eyes a coed (Carol Lynley) who is trying to live platonically with her boyfriend (Dean Jones).

title: Dr. Strangelove Or: How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Bomb
description: President Muffley and his advisers man the Pentagon war room, as planes with bombs head toward Moscow.

title: A Man for All Seasons
description: Sir Thomas More (Paul Scofield) opposes Henry VIII's (Robert Shaw) appointing himself head of the Church of England.

title: Anatomy of a Murder
description: A Michigan lawyer (James Stewart) and his colleague defend an Army lieutenant (Ben Gazzara) who killed the man who raped the officer's wife (Lee Remick).

title: Boston Blackie and the Law
description: Reformed thief Blackie (Chester Morris) does a magic show in a women's prison, during which an inmate escapes.

title: Port Afrique
description: An American (Phil Carey) returns to Morocco and discovers his wife's past while probing her death.

title: The Notorious Landlady
description: A U.S. diplomat (Jack Lemmon) tries to help his London landlady (Kim Novak) in a mix-up over jewels and her husband's murder.

title: The Whole Truth
description: A Hollywood producer's (Stewart Granger) wife (Donna Reed) does not believe he has stabbed his actress lover, another man's (George Sanders) wife.

title: Tight Spot
description: A detective (Brian Keith) guards a brassy blonde (Ginger Rogers) freed from prison to be a federal prosecutor's (Edward G. Robinson) key mob witness.

title: Murderers' Row
description: A secret agent blocks a villain's helio-beam plot in the second of four Matt Helm movies.

title: The Fuller Brush Girl
description: A door-to-door saleswoman (Lucille Ball) and her boyfriend (Eddie Albert) flee from mobsters and the police after a murder mix-up.

title: The Undercover Man
description: Two Treasury agents (Glenn Ford, James Whitmore) set out to nail a mobster for tax evasion.

title: Diamond Head
description: The head (Charlton Heston) of a Hawaiian pineapple dynasty refuses to let his sister (Yvette Mimieux) marry a native.

title: A Night to Remember
description: A mystery writer and his wife find a corpse in the backyard of their Greenwich Village apartment.

title: Hot Blood
description: A Gypsy king (Luther Adler) tricks his brother (Cornel Wilde) in Los Angeles into marrying a Roma bride (Jane Russell) that he bought.

title: Fire Down Below
description: A woman (Rita Hayworth) without a passport divides West Indies smugglers (Robert Mitchum, Jack Lemmon), then a fire threatens to sink a freighter.

title: Holiday
description: A tomboy New York socialite (Katharine Hepburn) flirts with her stuffy sister's (Doris Nolan) down-to-earth fiancé (Cary Grant).

title: Fail-Safe
description: The president (Henry Fonda) cannot stop a Strategic Air Command plane accidentally cued to bomb Moscow.

title: It Had to Be You
description: A marriage-shy sculptor (Ginger Rogers) meets the Indian boy of her childhood dreams, now a firefighter (Cornel Wilde).

title: The Trouble With Angels
description: A headstrong girl (Hayley Mills) and her best friend (June Harding) bedevil the mother superior (Rosalind Russell) of a convent school.

title: The End of the Affair
description: A civil servant's wife (Deborah Kerr) in wartime London vows to leave her injured lover (Van Johnson) if he recovers.

title: The Taming of the Shrew
description: Shakespeare's Petruchio weds Katharina on his own terms in Padua.

title: The Fuller Brush Man
description: A door-to-door salesman (Red Skelton) and his girlfriend (Janet Blair) solve a murder and wind up trapped in a war-surplus warehouse.

title: Three on a Couch
description: An artist tries to help his psychiatrist fiancée by posing as suitors for her lovesick patients.

title: 711 Ocean Drive
description: A telephone repairman (Edmond O'Brien) becomes the boss of a gambling syndicate he has ingeniously wired for profit.

title: Cat Ballou
description: When an outlaw (Lee Marvin) with a fake nose kills her father, a schoolmarm (Jane Fonda) hires his drunken twin to get revenge.

title: How to Save a Marriage and Ruin Your Life
description: A bachelor (Dean Martin) tries to save his buddy's (Eli Wallach) marriage by stealing his mistress, who is not who he thinks.

title: Hellcats of the Navy
description: A submarine commander (Ronald Reagan) enters the Sea of Japan with a frogman who had flirted with his girlfriend (Nancy Davis).

title: The Daring Young Man
description: After the military turns him down as being unfit, a man proves himself a hero by cracking a Nazi spy ring.

title: The Wrecking Crew
description: Secret agent Matt Helm (Dean Martin) and a blonde (Sharon Tate) track $1 billion in gold in the last of four Matt Helm movies.

title: Eight Iron Men
description: GIs sit in a bombed-out house with a comrade trapped outside; then one (Bonar Colleano) does something.

title: The Cockleshell Heroes
description: A British major (Jose Ferrer) and captain (Trevor Howard) lead marines in canoes on a mission to mine Nazi ships in Bordeaux.
